responsibility: This file implements an AArch64 RTL optimization pass that fuses condition-code-setting operations with the instruction that computes one of their inputs, primarily to improve SVE code generation around PTEST-based flag setting. Using rtl-ssa def-use information, it searches for CC-setting instructions that depend on a single-register producer in the same extended basic block, substitutes the producer’s SET_SRC into the CC setter, and rewrites the pair as a PARALLEL instruction when movement, recognition, and SSA validation succeed; the pass is exposed as make_pass_cc_fusion and is enabled for optimized SVE code.
